reviews.t: Its great! Its just the right amount of scrub
reviews.x: Its great! Its just the right amount of scrub. Ive tried ones that were so soft it felt like they weren't doing anything and others that hurt, this is just perfect! my skin has really been improving! a few weeks ago every part of my face had something on it and now I just have a spot or two on my chin/ around my mouth and most of it is just red marks from the issues I used to have! I like the body attachment, haven't used the pumice stone and have no idea what the spunky this is for XD

reviews.t: no power and less than acceptable attachments
reviews.x: rotate extremely slow.not powerful enough. when I tried to use the body brush attachment it did not function well at all the attachment constantly kept pausing as I was trying to use it.I will b returning it first thing in the morning.  .I ended up having to use my Manual back brush to finish exfoliating.

reviews.t: Little bit disappointed, by the big brush for body
reviews.x: Little bit disappointed, by the big brush for body, no strength, too slow, for a body scrub, the other brush are ok

reviews.t: I love this product so much
reviews.x: I love this product so much. I use it everyday in the shower and all the attachments are helpful. I have dropped it a few times and the bottom or top has come off but generally if you just let it dry for a bit it works just fine after.

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for
reviews.x: So far, I really like this brush.  I have not used all the attachments yet, but the small brush is excellent for use on the face.  It is quiet and easy to use.
Disappointed that the bristles weren't harder and speed wasn't faster.

I truly love this spin brush!! I've only had it for a few days or so but it seems to be working very well so far. I especially love the body brush and pumice stone attachments. I was able to achieve a nice lather with a minimal amount of soap. The speed is very sufficient and does the job. Very easy to handle & I haven't had any problems with the button functioning improperly nor did I find it was awkwardly placed, no problem with it shutting off & on during use. I could see and feel results aft

not very tight for my body brush (what i use). head falls off when not holding  it face up.  UPDATE! I was offered a second one and this one fits better. I will glue it in place cause i have 6 different brushes and only need the large heads rly.  The feet things, well pumice stones do nothing unless u spend an hour on a small area and there isnt much control at this speed. My father uses a hardware grater of sorts, for feet id go that route and will try myself

I was very pleased with this product for the first week then maybe two to three weeks later, it just stopped working. I put in new batteries. I tried everything and could not get it to work. I never got a chance to use all of the attachments because it didn't last long enough. So all in all this product is not a good deal for the money especially if you want to use it.

I love this brush. When I opened it up I thought it was going to be too soft, but it's actually just perfect. I've never used one before but my face is thanking me that I bought one. My face already feels smoother and I love that I can use it in the shower! Thanks for a fabulous product at a very reasonable price!

I use this product every single day and I can tell you it works great for exfoliating or just washing your face.  The little ones are perfect for sensitive skin like mine. I highly reccomend it to anyone that wants a good value item to use instead of the expensive ones that are out there
This is a great product. The strength and speed is good. Shipping was fast!! Will definitely order from this seller again!
I have only had the brush a few weeks. It the first one I have ever owned. So far it has lived up to expectations.
I like it very much! My fav is the sponge! Makes applying make up a breeze

reviews.t: Stopped working  after 10 days of use.
reviews.x: i don’t think it’s meant for everyday or long term use. I purchased this because my last face brush finally stopped working after almost 2years of use. This one was cheaper and had additional brush attachments so I figured I’d try it out. The two brush attachments are not good or all that gentle on the face. They started looking worn out after a day or two of use. I was willing to over look that issue because it got the job done while it worked anyways but this evening after only 10 days of use

So down fall for me was that it did not come with batteries so it took me a while to get to the store to purchase batteries to even try it. I feel that products should supply the first set of batteries or change it to a product that can be charged. This was an inconvenience for me which may not bother others.  Once I finally had power, I tried out the facial cleansing brush, the exfoliating body brush, the cosmetic sponge and the pumice stone. I really enjoyed the first two, which I interchanged

I gave this product ⭐️ not because of the item itself but how my skin reacts to it. I have sensitive skin and this brush tears the surface of my skin. I’ve experienced multiple breakouts and Inflamed skin after each use. The cause could be the brush or the speed in which the brush turns but I’m gonna give it the benefit of doubt and say it’s my skin. If you don’t have sensitive skin this product should cause no trouble.

reviews.t: Requires four AA batteries every week.
reviews.x: The brush works as well as you would expect a $17 motorized brush would work. The real problem is the life of the batteries and the potential cost. I used it twice a day for one week and had to replace the four AA batteries. It's probably fine for travel, especially if you don't want to risk damaging a higher priced machine. If you're looking for something for daily use, look for a rechargeable brush.

Just got this a few days ago and I love it. I had always wanted something similar to the Clarisonic that wasn't $100+. This inexpensive one is great and my face feels so much softer and my acne is starting to clear up. My only problem is the body brush attachment. I wanted it to help with my back acne but it is way harsher than the facial brush. It still gets the job done but it is a little painful.

I bought this product in January of this year and only used it up to 3 times per month. I used the product in the bath, but never submerged it. It suddenly stopped working in July. While it worked, it was great to use on my face. It was gentle but could give a great scrub if needed. It was nice to use for exfoliation before shaving my legs, but wasn't as rough as I'd like it to be for the legs.

Super affordable option for a face brush. I use the large head to scrub off my spray tan and the smaller one to wash my face. The only problem it that I wouldn’t recommend actually having it in the shower where it will get too wet because it gets wet  inside and stops working. The batteries would fall out of place sometimes and I’d have to shake the brush for it to turn back on

reviews.t: the product works well and has a good price value
reviews.x: This waterproof brush is a fairly solid product overall. Every component was included as advertised and the brush is functionally waterproof. Unfortunately, the brush has only one speed and the bristles on both the face and body brushes are of the same medium stiffness, which can be a bit rough on sensitive skin. However, the product works well and has a good price value.

reviews.t: Then I held it like normal and it was turning off
reviews.x: When I first tried this, I noticed that when I held the brush to my face, it was slowing down and then would stop.  I would flicker the power button on and off thinking that was the issue, but then when I held the brush upside down, it worked without turning off.  Then I held it like normal and it was turning off.  I think there is an electrical issue with the brush...

This facial cleansing brush,  is one of my new favorites facial products for the both morning and evening.With this one I  can easy change batteries when traveling without considering about the voltage problems in different country. I love the additional brush heads to make more functions.What is more, the price is really very cheap, which is just in my budget.

I give this a 5 stars the seller kept in contact with me and was very professional , it didn't come with batteries so I didn't try it right away but today I showered with it  .., it was amazing !! My skin feels so smooth  too bad I couldn't reach My back you gotta get someone to do that for you !! Anyways it's a great product and I'm not paid to do a review !!

claims.text: Many reviewers love the product and say it works well for exfoliating and washing, with several calling it perfect or great value.
A common complaint is that the motor lacks power and the rotation speed is too slow, especially for the body brush attachment.
Some reviewers report durability problems, with the device stopping working after only days or weeks of use.
Several reviewers mention issues with brush heads or attachments falling off or not fitting tightly.
Multiple reviewers praise the smaller brush heads as gentle and effective for facial use and sensitive skin.
